cues: Can for the present: Bishal can solve any sum in his head.
Could for a general ability in the past: at fourteen I could cycle to Bhairahawa.
But for one particular success on one occasion, use was able to: after three attempts they were able to reach the summit.
And where a modal cannot go, after will for instance, use be able to.
Never write can able to, or could not able to: use one or the other.
